newsitem.title: USA: Update of Diablo Canyon nuke status seen early Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Update of Diablo Canyon nuke status seen early Thurs.

text.p: An update on the status of the idled 1,073 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Diablo Canyon nuclear power plant in central California will not be available until 0900 PDT Thursday, a spokesman for Pacific Gas & Electric Co, the plant's owner, said late Wednesday.
The unit was taken off line at around 0500 PDT on Wednesday because of a problem with its feedwater system, but the company has not been able to determine the exact cause of the trip, he noted.
Diablo Canyon's 1,087 MW unit 1 was said to be operating normally.
